# Ikonos V2
**By Archergate** — built with Archergate Plugin Maker

## DSP Chain
- **Reverb**: Space & ambience
- **Distortion**: Saturation & grit

## Build via GitHub Actions (no compiler needed)

1. Create a free repo at github.com
2. Upload this folder
3. Go to Actions tab — build runs automatically (~5-10 min)
4. Download .vst3 from the Artifacts section

## Build locally

```bash
cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build --config Release
```

Install: copy `.vst3` to your DAW plugin folder and rescan.
